name: thesis-cs-symbolic-temperature-v1
minimum_rule: First minimum on the unchanged ascending 0..60 second grid; ties choose the shorter holding command
soft_action_rule: Keep the original normalized action clipping; change temperature only
reward: Unchanged global event passenger credit; generalized cost equals 2*waiting+onboard
selection: Report all fitted-model repetitions; choose feedback candidate by source weighted cost only, not target results
preservation: New directory only; frozen coefficients, checkpoints, normalization, simulator and manuscript unchanged
